Print jobs made by the Windows **RICOH MP 2014AD DDST** driver ("Print to
file", so nothing was printed), used to test counting Ricoh GDI jobs. Each
page says "Page N".

| File | Pages | Copies | Sides |
|---|---|---|---|
| `simplex-1.prn` | 1 | 1 | one-sided |
| `simplex-3.prn` | 3 | 1 | one-sided |
| `simplex-2-copies2.prn` | 2 | 2 | one-sided |
| `duplex-long-3.prn` | 3 | 1 | two-sided, long edge |
| `duplex-short-3.prn` | 3 | 1 | two-sided, short edge |
